home.title: Shipilka Gathering
home.description: An information site for the Shipilka Gathering held in VRChat, with event archives and participation rules.
home.heroBody: Shipilka Gathering is a meetup for the Shipilka avatar, mainly held in VRChat. First-timers and returning visitors are both welcome.
closingLines: That's the end of the scroll.
home.heroImageAlt: An illustration of many Shipilkas gathered around the moon
home.heroBottomAlt: An illustration of many Shipilkas standing on a mirror-like lake

sections.title: MUST
sections.imageAlt: An illustration of Shipilka raising a finger to give a warning

items.text: You must use the Shipilka avatar.
children: At minimum, you must use the face (Body) of Shipilka.

items.text: If the staffs give you instructions, please follow them.
children: If the instance becomes too crowed, we may ask you to move to a new one.

sections.title: CAN
sections.imageAlt: An illustration of Shipilka standing in a welcoming pose

items.text: You can join with a sample avatar.
children: If you don’t have one, please ask the staff for help.

items.text: You can take photos during the event.
children: Photos may be shared on social media or used for event announcements.

sections.title: MUST NOT
sections.imageAlt: An illustration of Shipilka upside down as a warning

items.text: Do not use avatars that fall into any of the following categories:
children: Are extreme or disrespectful “chimera” versions of the original avatar

items.text: Do not engage in harassment or rude behaviour.

sections.footer: The staff may remove you from the instance without prior warning.

disclaimerDescription: This site and gathering are an unofficial volunteer project created by fans of the 3D model "Shipilka."
The model rights holder, "かなﾘぁ" (KANAlia), is not involved in the operation, funding, or content of this project. For inquiries, please contact the organizer, "狐威ミコト", or the staff.
